verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim handling of forms, CAPTCHAs, and login walls (docs-8, docs-10, docs-13) as part of agent workflows, and features like pauseWhen (docs-23) suggest human-in-the-loop escalation when needed rather than fully silent bypass. However, there is no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating CAPTCHA-solving success rates or specifics on which CAPTCHA types are handled, and no third-party validation of this specific capability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CAPTCHA-solving success, technical detail on how CAPTCHAs are defeated, and confirmation this works without fallback to manual intervention.
